points.description: Core idea of k-NN: a new data point is compared with labelled/classified stored data, its k nearest points (neighbours by distance) are found, and the new point is assigned the class with the majority vote among them. Pseudo-code or step-by-step description in any wording is fine.
points.partial_credit: 1 mark if only part is given, e.g. finds nearest neighbours but no voting/class assignment, or a vague description of classifying by similar known data.

rubric.notes: Full marks for a description (pseudo-code or plain steps) that finds the k nearest labelled points to the new point and assigns the majority class. Give 1 mark if the answer is vague or misses one key part (neighbour search or the vote). Give 0 if it is off-topic or describes a different method. Ignore the model answer's word "unsupervised"; do not penalise for it.
